samples.xml_description:
<module id="traffic_light">
    <description>A traffic light controller with red, yellow, and green indicators, controlled by a pedestrian button.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="rst_n">Active-low reset.</input>
        <input id="clk">Clock.</input>
        <input id="pass_request">Request signal for pedestrians.</input>
        <output id="clock" width_description="[7:0]">Count value of the internal counter.</output>
        <output id="red">Red light indicator.</output>
        <output id="yellow">Yellow light indicator.</output>
        <output id="green">Green light indicator.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <enum id="idle">Idle state.</enum>
        <enum id="s1_red">State 1 - Red.</enum>
        <enum id="s2_yellow">State 2 - Yellow.</enum>
        <enum id="s3_green">State 3 - Green.</enum>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <reg id="cnt" width="8">Internal counter for timing.</reg>
        <reg id="state" width="2">Current state of the traffic light controller.</reg>
        <reg id="p_red">Previous value of the red signal.</reg>
        <reg id="p_yellow">Previous value of the yellow signal.</reg>
        <reg id="p_green">Previous value of the green signal.</reg>
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        // State transition logic
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                state <= s1_red;
                cnt <= 8'd10;
                p_red <= 1'b0;
                p_yellow <= 1'b0;
                p_green <= 1'b0;
            end else begin
                case (state)
                    s1_red: begin
                        if (cnt == 8'd0) begin
                            state <= s3_green;
                            cnt <= 8'd60;
                        end
                    end
                    s2_yellow: begin
                        if (cnt == 8'd0) begin
                            state <= s1_red;
                            cnt <= 8'd5;
                        end
                    end
                    s3_green: begin
                        if (cnt == 8'd0) begin
                            state <= s2_yellow;
                            cnt <= 8'd10;
                        end
                    end
                    default: state <= s1_red;
                endcase
            end
        end

        // Counting logic
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (!rst_n || pass_request && p_green) begin
                cnt <= 8'd10;
            end else if (!p_green && p_green == 1'b1) begin
                cnt <= 8'd60;
            end else if (!p_yellow && p_yellow == 1'b1) begin
                cnt <= 8'd5;
            end else if (!p_red && p_red == 1'b1) begin
                cnt <= 8'd10;
            end else begin
                cnt <= cnt - 1;
            end
        end

        // Output logic
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                red <= 1'b0;
                yellow <= 1'b0;
                green <= 1'b0;
            end else begin
                red <= p_red;
                yellow <= p_yellow;
                green <= p_green;
            end
        end

        // Assign outputs to internal state variables
        assign p_red = red;
        assign p_yellow = yellow;
        assign p_green = green;

        // Assign the counter value to the output
        assign clock = cnt;
    </implementation>
</module>
